data.title: Maha Villas
data.about:
Living at Maha Villas in Expo Valley is about more than simply finding a place to sleep; it's about creating a balanced lifestyle that incorporates space, nature, and modern conveniences. With a selection of standalone 5 Bedroom Villas , these detached homes are the pinnacle of luxury living. 

Immerse yourself in a vibrant community where all the necessities are conveniently located, guaranteeing that your every need is satisfied in this tranquil sanctuary.

Maha Villas by Expo City, located in the center of Expo Valley, revolutionizes eco-friendly living. Spacious luxury residences that harmoniously fit with their natural surroundings may be found here, amidst flourishing green landscapes. Just outside your window, you may feel the calming embrace of nature as you wake up.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Nature at Maha Villas Expo Valley
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Sustainable Luxury: Live sustainably in lush green landscapes with unique cooling topography and uninterrupted nature reserve views
  • Prime Location: Minutes from Expo City Dubai, enjoy easy access to all amenities.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: Benefit from 70/30 two-year post-handover payment plans.
  • Ample Parking: Underground parking for up to three cars.
  • Variety: Multiple 5BR villa types to choose from.
  • Convenience: Some villa types offer "Lift" options.
  • Culinary Freedom: Choose between "Show Kitchen" and closed kitchen layouts.
  • Spacious Living: Enjoy built-up areas from 6,901 sqft to 7,535 sqft.
  • Generous Plots: Villas come with plot areas ranging from 7,537 sqft to 13,261 sqft.

location_tile.title: Prime Location in Expo City
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Expo Valley is your gateway to a world of natural beauty, with villas and townhouses gracefully situated amidst a captivating landscape that boasts stunning views of a nature reserve, lake, and wadi. This idyllic community, nestled within Expo City Dubai, artfully combines lush green surroundings with the convenience of urban living. These homes offer the perfect blend of seclusion and connectivity, providing you with a harmonious living experience that seamlessly integrates nature, space, and convenience. With Expo City Dubai's vibrant attractions at your fingertips, you'll enjoy a life where the best of both worlds coexist.

  • 15 mins from Dubai Metro
  • 20 mins from Palm Jumeirah
  • 25 mins from Meydan
  • 30 mins from Downtown Dubai
  • 50 mins Dubai International Airport
